response.sql: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT p.bats AS batting_hand, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fielding AS f JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id GROUP BY p.bats), totals AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count, AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM hand_counts) SELECT h.batting_hand, h.record_count, 1.0 * h.record_count / t.total_count AS share, h.record_count - t.average_count AS above_average FROM hand_counts AS h CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE h.record_count > t.average_count
